breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the incorrect statement 'pressure increases toward the center of curvature' verbatim from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth correctly indicates that with n directed outward, dP/dn = rho*V²/R is positive, meaning pressure increases outward (away from the center of curvature). The agent failed to correct this reversed pressure gradient direction.
